selectionCriteria: Discover each fixed institution through public HTTP and independently inspect public navigation and actual current-page content.
Choose a new useful page that presents at least three substantive salient current-page functions in the pilot categories.
Prefer user-facing page-level service entry, actionable information, notices, academic help, or public reference tasks over a page selected solely for global utilities.
Determine expected functions and task before any product execution or feedback.
Use only publicly reachable, unauthenticated content. Do not submit forms, enter input, log in, activate downloads, or invoke business controls.

rules: Exclude all prior URL aliases after URL normalization.
Exclude same-content redirects and pages whose canonical public content is the same as an excluded page.
Preserve all rejected or replaced discovery candidates with reason and original evidence.
Do not replace a page because it performs poorly under product evaluation.

captureProtocol.browser: Isolated headless Playwright context only; no existing profile or visible browser. CLI HTTP discovery permitted.
captureProtocol.capture: Save original HTTP response, full live DOM, full original body and ancestor structure, document URL/base, style resources and visibility/accessibility/control inventories.
captureProtocol.offline: Keep attributes including href, target, onclick, ARIA, form and control types unchanged; add metadata data-eval-id only. Apply CSP that disables original scripts/handlers and requests in replay; do not invent behavior stubs.
captureProtocol.privacy: Sanitize input text/textarea values and private editable content before retained HTML/proof; public static labels retained.
captureProtocol.fidelity: Preserve original DOM order, headings, forms, tables, ancestors, CSS, visibility and names; save hashes and preprocessing provenance.

actions.navigate: Ordinary HTTP(S) URLs, plain login form links, and cross-document fragments.
actions.locate: Explicit JS/handler, SSO, popup, download, role button, ARIA control, or same-document fragment; never execute.

semantics: Function and document purpose determine category.
Distinguish service entry from explanation or information documents.
Do not infer hidden effects from words alone.
Annotate all retained visible meaningful controls as accepted or rejected, including actual search inputs.
Expected groups use actual annotation IDs and substantive current-page functions; maximum three expected groups per page.

freezeProtocol: Run source-fidelity and annotation correspondence self-QA before freeze.
Freeze dataset, observation and proof files in a manifest with path, SHA-256 and bytes.
Retain immutable plan, source captures and preprocessing hashes.
Report only counts, paths, hashes and status until engine freeze and first execution; never send semantic findings or fresh page identities.
